evidence_summary.binding_rationale: ROI localization, slice selection, and coordinate targets are anatomy- and dataset-specific.
Volume resampling, view construction, and 3D augmentation depend on scan geometry.
The 3D or multiview backbone can be implemented with MONAI, PyTorch, or competition-specific model code.
Auxiliary coordinate, segmentation, and weighted classification losses are benchmark-specific.
Patient GroupKFold, TTA, and calibration are validation-driven operations.
